_proposed_method.note: The PREDICTIVE+CHURN policy implements predictive, churn-aware overlapping clustering. It uses the existing Phase-2B horizon-averaged objective and churn_aware_decision (src/optimization/churn_aware.py). The full two-timescale integration (src/optimization/two_timescale.py) further wraps this with fast-timescale physical power control but uses the same slow-timescale clustering decision. PREDICTIVE+CHURN is the relevant clustering benchmark.
